get.description:
Last.fm (Audioscrobbler 2.0) compatible API. Point a scrobbler's "custom Last.fm
server" setting at this server's `/2.0/`.

**Signing.** Signed methods need `api_sig`: take every parameter except `format`,
`callback` and `api_sig`, sort by name, concatenate each name followed by its
value, append your application's shared secret, and take the md5 hex digest.

**Sessions.** Methods that act as a user need `sk`, a session key from
`auth.getMobileSession` or the desktop flow (`auth.getToken`, approval at
`/api/auth/`, then `auth.getSession`).

**Errors** use Last.fm's codes: 2 (Invalid service), 3 (Invalid Method), 4 (Authentication Failed), 6 (Invalid parameters), 8 (Operation failed), 9 (Invalid session key), 10 (Invalid API key), 13 (Invalid method signature supplied), 14 (Unauthorized Token), 15 (This token has expired), 29 (Rate limit exceeded).

## Methods
### `auth.getMobileSession`

Create a session key from a username and password.

*Requires:* signed.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `username` | yes | Username |
| `password` | yes | Password (send over HTTPS, as a POST body) |

The legacy `authToken` (md5 of username + md5(password)) form is not supported, because it requires storing unsalted password hashes. Clients that only support it (such as pylast's `password_hash`) should use the desktop flow instead.

### `auth.getSession`

Exchange an approved token for a session key (desktop auth flow, step 3).

*Requires:* signed.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `token` | yes | Token from auth.getToken, approved by the user |

### `auth.getToken`

Fetch an unapproved request token (desktop auth flow, step 1).

*Requires:* signed.

Send the user to `/api/auth/?api_key=…&token=…` to approve the token, then call auth.getSession. Tokens expire after 60 minutes.

### `track.scrobble`

Scrobble up to 50 tracks.

*Requires:* signed, session key.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `artist[i]` | yes | Artist name |
| `track[i]` | yes | Track title |
| `timestamp[i]` | yes | Unix time the track started playing |
| `album[i]` | no | Album title |
| `albumArtist[i]` | no | Album artist, if different from the track artist |
| `duration[i]` | no | Track length in seconds |
| `trackNumber[i]` | no | Position on the album |
| `mbid[i]` | no | MusicBrainz track id |

Tracks are array parameters indexed from 0 (`artist[0]`, `track[0]`, ...); a single un-indexed track is also accepted. Tracks are ignored (not an error) when the artist or track is empty (codes 1/2), the timestamp is over 14 days old (3) or more than 5 minutes in the future (4). Re-sending an already stored scrobble is accepted, so retries are safe.

### `track.updateNowPlaying`

Set the track the user is listening to now.

*Requires:* signed, session key.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `artist` | yes | Artist name |
| `track` | yes | Track title |
| `album` | no | Album title |
| `albumArtist` | no | Album artist |
| `duration` | no | Track length in seconds; now-playing expires after it |
| `trackNumber` | no | Position on the album |
| `mbid` | no | MusicBrainz track id |

Now playing expires after the track's duration (10 minutes if not given).

### `user.getInfo`

A user's profile and play count.

*Requires:* api_key only.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `user` | yes | Username to fetch data for |

### `user.getRecentTracks`

Recently scrobbled tracks, newest first, led by the now-playing track.

*Requires:* api_key only.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `user` | yes | Username to fetch data for |
| `limit` | no | Results per page (default 50, max 200) |
| `page` | no | Page number (default 1) |
| `from` | no | Only scrobbles at or after this Unix time |
| `to` | no | Only scrobbles at or before this Unix time |

### `user.getTopAlbums`

Most played albums over a period.

*Requires:* api_key only.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `user` | yes | Username to fetch data for |
| `period` | no | overall | 7day | 1month | 3month | 6month | 12month (default overall) |
| `limit` | no | Results per page (default 50, max 1000) |
| `page` | no | Page number (default 1) |

### `user.getTopArtists`

Most played artists over a period.

*Requires:* api_key only.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `user` | yes | Username to fetch data for |
| `period` | no | overall | 7day | 1month | 3month | 6month | 12month (default overall) |
| `limit` | no | Results per page (default 50, max 1000) |
| `page` | no | Page number (default 1) |

### `user.getTopTracks`

Most played tracks over a period.

*Requires:* api_key only.

| Parameter | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `user` | yes | Username to fetch data for |
| `period` | no | overall | 7day | 1month | 3month | 6month | 12month (default overall) |
| `limit` | no | Results per page (default 50, max 1000) |
| `page` | no | Page number (default 1) |

get.description: Sharing is off and posts are followers-only until you change them.

patch.description:
Turning sharing on makes you findable as your handle. Your handle can't change once
people follow you. Visibility changes apply to new posts only. Turning sharing off
deletes your posts and removes all your followers (each is told).

get.description: What it would say right now, for the week still in progress. Never posted or stored.

Newest first, including deleted ones (their text stays visible to you; deleted_at
shows when).

delete.description: Sends a Delete to whoever received it.

404.description: No one sharing with that name

get.description: For the web UI's profile page. Only users who share are visible.

404.description: Not found, not public, or deleted

get.description:
For the web UI's post page (the browser landing spot for a Note's `url`, since it
can't itself speak ActivityPub).
Newest first. Filter with `state=pending` (requests) or `state=accepted`.

post.description: They stop receiving your posts. They can follow you again; block them to prevent it.
Removes them and refuses their future follows.

delete.description:
Their server is told (an Undo of the Block). They can follow you again; they aren't
re-added.

tags.name: Apps
tags.description: API applications. Each has an API key and shared secret that a scrobbling client uses against the Last.fm-compatible `/2.0/` endpoint.

tags.name: Sessions
tags.description: Last.fm session keys issued to scrobbling clients on your behalf.

tags.name: Tokens
tags.description: Approve Last.fm desktop-auth tokens. Clients send the user to `/api/auth/`, which redirects to the UI's approve page, which calls these endpoints.

tags.name: Imports
tags.description: Import listening history from a Last.fm export file, or straight from Last.fm. Imports run in the background; poll a job to follow its progress.
